name: Musselwick Farm Cottages
accommodation: Five cottages sleeping 2 to 12, each with a hot tub
confirmedFeatures: Hot tubs, courtyard with firepits, pizza oven and BBQ, Wi-Fi, EV chargers
overview: Musselwick Farm has five clifftop cottages above Musselwick Sands, reached through Marloes village. Each has a hot tub and the courtyard has firepits and a pizza oven.
surfTripFit: A group can share the large Mill House, with hot tubs after a day on the beaches near Marloes.
